leverage.exposure: No leveraged position is open right now — the balance is positive and nothing has settled. If all four raised bids land, the balance goes negative before the unwind, which is fine on the clock but not optional to fix: a negative balance at matchday start scores zero for the entire matchday. Selling Sylla and Bernardo clears it comfortably and leaves the squad able to field a five-three-two, with Widmer and Lokonga in reserve if more room is needed. The spending floor is nowhere near binding. There is ample time before the lock, but the unwind must happen before it.

binding_gap: The squad is under a full complement, so no legal formation can be filled and the empty slot is costing a flat points penalty every matchday it persists. Any one of the three live auctions closes it. The order that matters is by expiry, not by value: Nguefack resolves first, then ter Horst, then Maluze. If all three are still lost by midday tomorrow, buy any cheap outfield body immediately — and never a second keeper, because only one goalkeeper can be fielded and a second one leaves too few outfield players to fill anything.

verdict.detail: Kickbase repriced every market value at the daily tick forty-five minutes before this run, and that single event broke three of Georg's four live bids. Nguefack and Maluze both jumped by more than half their value, which silently turned two bids that were placed at a healthy premium into bids sitting well below market value — below the lowest clearing premium ever measured in this league. They will lose as they stand. ter Horst was repriced upward too, and Georg's bid, which was above the previous record clearing when he placed it, now sits below every contested Kickbase clearing on record. This run therefore reverses two explicit standing instructions from the last run — 'do NOT raise the bid' on ter Horst and 'HOLD the bid, do not raise' on Maluze. Both were right against the old values and are wrong against the new ones. Raise all three. Nguefack expires in the small hours of German time, so that one has to be done tonight or it is lost.

sell.reason: No change to the sell plan. Sylla remains the first sale to make the moment a buy lands and the squad is legal again — he is the worst scorer in the squad and Club Brugge is still preparing a last-minute bid, with Schalke's asking price cut and the club saying openly that a sale is in its budget. A caution for future runs: a Sky Sport headline reading 'Moussa Sylla verlaesst Schalke 04' is from January, describes a move to New York that subsequently collapsed, and must not be read as a completed exit. Bernardo follows Sylla. Lokonga and Widmer stay as later, lower-priority funding sales.

Sell the moment the allowance exists.

buy.reason: Same four players, all repriced. ter Horst is the points buy that also fixes the formation hole — a verified full-match starter with the best points-per-euro of any confirmed starter on the board, entering the eleven ahead of Widmer. Maluze is the standout on points-per-euro overall, and Frankfurt's injury list has grown around him, which protects rather than threatens his minutes. Nguefack stays what he always was — a body to fill the empty slot, never to be fielded — and is the most urgent action because he expires first. Eggestein is the optional fourth leg with no deadline pressure; his is a manager ask, so it is benchmarked against the low cluster, not the high one. On benchmarking generally: a rival won Vagnoman off this same board an hour before this run at a premium that is now the highest mid-price clearing on record, which is fresh evidence for bidding the high cluster on contested Kickbase listings. Every auction lost so far was lost by underbidding.

standing.name: Eggestein
standing.why: LOWEST PRIORITY of the four raises - do this one only after the three blind auctions are handled, and it is optional even then. BUY B3cqt6r stays the underlying position and remains open; this records the price revision. The 20:00:00Z repricing lifted Eggestein 15.463.xxx -> 16.461.566, so Georg's standing offer of 16.305.809 - which was pitched at mv - is now MINUS 0,95% against mv, i.e. below every manager-ask clearing ever measured here (+3,06% Fuellkrug, +4,35% Bornauw). A manager can simply sit on it, and Borussia Rumpelfuss has already sat on this listing for 8 days since 24.08. RAISE TO 16.965.000 = +3,06% over mv, exactly the measured median manager-ask clearing - the LOW cluster is the right benchmark here, not the high cluster that governs contested Kickbase board auctions. Note this is still 235.000 BELOW his 17.200.000 ask (+4,49%), which is itself inside the measured manager band, so simply accepting the ask is a defensible alternative if he refuses. VALUE: ap 119 in place of Sambi Lokonga ap 44 is +75 ap on the fielded XI, and Lokonga's 10.275.305 covers most of the cost. VERIFIED: Ligainsider 27.08.2026 projects him starting Freiburg's midfield alongside Engelhardt; NOT on the Verletzte-und-Gesperrte table re-fetched this run; st=0. NO DEADLINE PRESSURE - a manager ask does not expire, so this can wait until the auctions resolve and the leverage picture is clear. CAUTION: this is the leg that drives the deepest negative balance. With all four legs at the raised prices (9,70M + 2,00M + 1,45M + 16,97M = 30,12M against cash 20.53M) the balance bottoms at about -9,59M, unwound by Sylla 9,23M + Bernardo 6,71M to about +6,35M at 12 players. That is fine with 93,6h to the lock, but a NEGATIVE balance at matchday start scores ZERO for the whole matchday, so the unwind is not optional.

The 900.000 bid Georg has live is therefore no longer +25,9% over mv, it is MINUS 18,86% - below the minimum clearing premium ever measured in this league (-0,78%, n=22). A bid below mv has never won here. It is a dead bid and will simply lose. CRITICAL TIMING: all three of Georg's blind auctions expire BEFORE the next mv update, so tonight's values are the FINAL values these auctions clear against - there is no further drift to wait out and no reason to defer the raise to a later run. Nguefack expires 2026-09-01T02:11Z, which is 04:11 German time. Georg will be asleep for the last two runs before it resolves, so this raise happens now or not at all. RAISE TO 1.450.000 = +30,7% over mv 1.109.172, absolute overpay exposure ~340k. He remains a BODY (ap 17), not a points play - never field him. His job is the 11th slot: squad is 10, legal formations NONE, and the empty slot is a live -100. Insurance at 1,45M against a 100-point penalty is cheap, and he stays worth it even if ter Horst and Maluze also land, because the target end state is 12.
